# DropTower

Vertical drop tower: a ring gondola that climbs then drops.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# LogFlume

Log flume water ride: an elevated trough with a log boat of riders.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# Monorail

Elevated monorail beam on piers with a streamlined gliding train.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# HauntedMansion

A crooked haunted mansion dark ride with flickering windows.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# SwingRide

Chair swing / wave-swinger: chained chairs flung out from a spinning canopy.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# GoKarts

Go-kart circuit: an oval asphalt track with four karts racing around it.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# MineTrainCar

Mine-train ore-cart vehicle with iron bands and a prospector.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# BobsleighCar

Sleek two-seat bobsleigh on chrome runners in a banked chute.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.
